scripts.build: nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-contracts build && nub run -r --filter './sites/*' --filter './services/*' --if-present build
scripts.test: nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-contracts test && nub run --filter @codeops/agents-ui test && nub run -r --filter './services/*' --if-present --workspace-concurrency 4 test
scripts.acceptance:golden: nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-contracts build && nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-control-gateway build && nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-plane-controller build && nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-session-runtime-worker build && node services/codeops-acceptance-runner/src/golden-dogfood.mjs
scripts.acceptance:agents-ui: nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-contracts build && nub run --filter @codeops/agents-ui build && nub run --filter @codeops/acceptance-runner test:browser
scripts.check:chart: nub run prepare:chart && node --test infra/scripts/test-codeops-action.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-agent-onboarding.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-chart.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-smoke.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeopsctl.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-release-consumer-lock.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-release-version.mjs infra/scripts/test-agents-system-root-session.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-golden-release-evidence.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-license-policy.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-quickstart-docs.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-release-chart.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-release-images.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-release-recovery-workflow.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-release-workflow.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-repository-registry-validator.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-vps-k3s.mjs infra/scripts/test-standalone-image-packaging.mjs
scripts.prove:lifecycle-relay: nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-contracts build && nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-control-gateway build && node infra/scripts/prove-lifecycle-jetstream-relay.mjs
scripts.evaluate: nub run prepare:chart && nub run build && nub run test && node --test infra/scripts/test-codeops-chart.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-quickstart-docs.mjs infra/scripts/test-codeops-agent-onboarding.mjs
scripts.verify: nub run check:licenses && nub run build && nub run typecheck && nub run test && nub run acceptance:golden && nub run check:chart
